introduction: Plants don't have a nervous system, so how do they respond to sunlight, gravity, or know when to drop their leaves or ripen their fruit? They do this entirely through chemical messengers called Plant Hormones (Phytohormones).

core_concepts.title: Auxin (The Growth Hormone)
core_concepts.description:
Function: Responsible for 'Cell Elongation' and 'Apical Dominance' (making the plant grow taller rather than wider). 
Tropism: Auxin is responsible for Phototropism. It accumulates on the shaded side of the stem, causing that side to grow faster, making the plant 'bend towards the light'.

core_concepts.title: Gibberellins
core_concepts.description: Function: Responsible for the massive 'Elongation of the Stem/Internodes' (can make dwarf plants grow tall) and helps in breaking seed dormancy (triggering seed germination).

core_concepts.title: Cytokinins
core_concepts.description:
Function: Promotes rapid 'Cell Division' (Cytokinesis). 
Key Fact: It is known as the anti-aging hormone of plants because it delays the senescence (aging and yellowing) of leaves.

core_concepts.title: Ethylene (The Ripening Hormone)
core_concepts.description: Function: It is the **ONLY Gaseous Hormone** in plants. Its primary function is the 'Natural Ripening of Fruits'.

core_concepts.title: Abscisic Acid (ABA - The Stress Hormone)
core_concepts.description: Function: It is a 'Growth Inhibitor'. It prepares the plant to survive extreme stress (like drought) by closing the stomata to prevent water loss, and promotes the 'wilting and falling off' of older leaves and fruits.

important_entities.name: Plant Movements (Tropism)
important_entities.significance:
1. Phototropism: Movement towards light (Shoot is positive, Root is negative). 
2. Geotropism: Movement towards gravity (Root is positive, Shoot is negative). 
3. Hydrotropism: Movement towards water (Roots are highly positively hydrotropic).

trap_alerts_and_exceptions.explanation: Exam Trap: If asked 'Which hormone naturally ripens fruits?', the answer is **Ethylene**. However, if asked 'Which chemical is used for ARTIFICIAL ripening of fruits?', the answer is **Calcium Carbide** (which produces Acetylene gas).

mnemonics_and_tricks.explanation: The word itself tells you its function: Cytokinin triggers cytokinesis (the division of cells).

exam_strategy_tips: A highly repeated question in almost all competitive exams: 'Which is the only plant hormone that exists in a gaseous state?' Answer: Ethylene.
